event.description: Reduce interleaved model feed-forward width from 24 to 16
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 4,512 parameters at 99.980000%, a +0.980000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 3 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0007, ff_dim=24 at 4,512 parameters and 99.98% official accuracy; the most recent failed result is attempt-0001, an optimization failure under the superseded separated-token representation with no official score. Hypothesis: the interleaved model may not require an expanding FF hidden state; reducing ff_dim 24->16 is parameterization-preserving compression that removes 512 parameters and tests a square d_model-to-FF mapping. This is more informative than the nearest untested ff_dim=20 because width 24 retained a 0.98-point official margin and a decisive step exposes whether expansion itself is necessary before changing attention organization.
